thread:
emma_devex: Quick heads-up — our sampleapp rerank CI started failing after the SDK updates. Node SDK embeds are length 1536, Python ones are 1537, so the reranker throws a shape error. Also seeing intermittent 401s on retries when batching helper is enabled. Anyone else hit this?

josh_infra: Hmm, 401 on retry + batching helper sounds like the auth header is being duplicated on retry (server rejects). Can you paste the raw responses / minimal repro?

emma_devex: Pasting minimal repro (sanitized):
```bash
# node sample call (fails rerank)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input": ["a","b","c"], "model":"open-embed-1536"}'
# response snippet
{"data":[{"id":"1","vector":[0.001,0.12,...],"metadata":{}},...]}
```
And python call returns: "embedding": [ ... ] (length 1537) — sampleapp expects `vector` and 1536 dims.

For the 401 I see logs like: `401 Unauthorized - multiple Authorization headers` after an SDK retry:
```
Error: 401 Unauthorized
 at Client.request (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/src/index.js:123:15)
```

carlos_sdk: Thanks for the repro. Two separate issues here: 1) header duplication on retry was caused by our axios retry wrapper re-attaching Authorization without clearing the original header — fix in the Node SDK landed (1.4.2). 2) The Python SDK had an accidental padding step we added for an experimental quantized embedding path which padded to 1537 for alignment on one CPU build — that was a mistake and has been reverted.

carlos_sdk: Workarounds until you can upgrade:
- Node: set client option `retries: 0` or disable batching helper (`batching: false`)
- Python: explicitly read `vector` or `embedding` and slice to 1536, e.g. `embed = resp.get('vector') or resp.get('embedding'); embed = embed[:1536]`

marie_docs: We'll patch the sampleapp README and migration notes. Action items: update the sampleapp to detect both `vector` and `embedding`, and add a small function `normalize_embedding()` that trims/pads to expected dim + mention SDK minimum versions.

kate_support: Noted a customer hit this in prod when they flipped batching helpers on. Quick customer-safe guidance: upgrade SDKs ASAP (node@1.4.2+, python@1.4.3+) or temporarily disable the helper and use server-side batching until they can upgrade. Also advise them to validate embedding length before calling rerank to avoid crashes.

emma_devex: Thanks — trying upgrade now. Commands?

carlos_sdk: Node: `npm i @redwood/sdk@^1.4.2`
Python: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.4.3`
Also note: v1.4.x changed response key from `embedding` -> `vector` in one of the endpoints for parity; sampleapp had mixed handling which caused the confusion. Migration note will be explicit.

release-bot: :rocket: Released @redwood/sdk v1.4.2 to npm and redwood-sdk 1.4.3 to PyPI (patches: retry-header fix, python padding revert, sampleapp docs).

emma_devex: Upgraded both SDKs and ran CI — rerank tests now green, no more 401s after retries. Thanks all! :tada:

marie_docs: I'll drop a PR to update the sampleapp and add a short snippet to the onboarding guide: `normalize_embedding(resp) -> list[float]` and a checklist item "confirm embedding dim matches reranker".

emma_devex: Leaving a small follow-up: can we add an SDK debug flag that logs when a retry mutates headers? Helped root-causing this for me.

carlos_sdk: Good idea — filing an internal issue and will propose a small opt-in `debug.retryHeaders=true` flag in the next minor.

emma_devex: Great, resolving on our side. Leaving thread here for record.
